Samantha — perfect, thanks for the quick reply and the slot confirmation.

Answers inline:
1) Data residency: Redwood Hosted writes aggregated usage metrics to multi-region telemetry by default. For region-locked logs and storage we have two options: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity in a single region) or Redwood Private (customer-managed VPC). I added both fallback rows to the infra appendix in the MAP and flagged the customer choices as decision points.

2) Evaluation harness: added a short eval artifacts zip (sample prompts + scoring script) to the doc and linked a reproducibility README. Link is in the 'evaluation artifacts' section of the MAP. If your ML team wants the raw artifacts off-GDrive, we can provide a signed transfer.

I updated the MAP with the infra bullets and a short acceptance metric template per Marissa's suggestions. Jonas will join Tue 11/2 10:00 PT — invite and calendar hold sent.

Next steps for FastBank:
- Pre-populate the 'Stakeholders' and 'Legal gating items' rows before Tue so we can answer procurement questions live.
- Confirm whether audit logs must be retained > 1 year (we've flagged a note if so).

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.
